titleByLocale.fr: Soutien aux ventes institutionnelles (gestion de l'ensemble)

jobs.description:
Have you gained initial experience supporting institutional clients in asset management and want to build a career in institutional sales? If you are passionate about investments, relationship management and business development, this role offers a strong entry into one of Switzerland’s leading asset managers.

Within the Swiss Institutional Clients team, you will support pension funds, insurers and family offices, contributing to both new business development and the maintenance of long-term client relationships.

This role targets ambitious candidates aiming to move into a client-facing relationship management position within three years. You will initially support senior Relationship Managers, build a deep understanding of clients, products and sales processes, and gradually take on more responsibility, including direct client interaction.

We provide the training, exposure and mentorship needed to succeed in institutional sales. In return, we seek motivated, curious individuals eager to develop into trusted business developers and eventually manage institutional client relationships independently.

The position suits candidates with first experience in client servicing, sales support or relationship management in asset management who are ready to take the next step into a front-office sales role.

What would your role be?

• You support Relationship Managers in managing and growing institutional client relationships.

• You prepare presentations, sales materials, market updates and portfolio reviews as well as coordinate client meetings, events and follow-ups to ensure a seamless experience.

• You support RFPs, DDQs as well as client information requests.

• You maintain CRM data, sales pipelines and reporting as well as contribute to process improvements and digital initiatives.

• In a second step, you link the team members with one Vontobel investment boutique and become the team’s content expert for this asset class.

• In a final step, you join client events, meetings and pitches to learn the relationship management role.

What are we looking for?

• Initial experience within institutional client servicing, sales support, client relationship management or a similar role within asset management.

• A clear ambition to pursue a long-term career in institutional sales and client relationship management.

• Master’s degree with an excellent academic record, seeking an opportunity in an international work environment

• Strong interest in financial markets, investments and institutional asset management.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Proactive, curious and commercially minded with a strong sense of ownership.

• Fluency in German and English.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint and Word), with ideally some experience of CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce) and the effective use of data and AI tools for market intelligence, research and analytical purposes.

What do we offer?

• Opportunity to work for a leading active asset manager in an international environment and develop expertise in active asset management working with institutional clients

• Top Zurich location

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in over 25 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hai acquisito un'esperienza iniziale a supporto dei clienti istituzionali nella gestione degli asset e vuoi costruire una carriera nelle vendite istituzionali? Se siete appassionati di investimenti, gestione delle relazioni e sviluppo aziendale, questo ruolo offre un forte ingresso in uno dei principali asset manager della Svizzera.

All'interno del team dei Clienti Istituzionali Svizzeri, supporterete i fondi pensione, gli assicuratori e gli uffici familiari, contribuendo sia al nuovo sviluppo aziendale che al mantenimento delle relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine.

Questo ruolo si rivolge a candidati ambiziosi che mirano a trasferirsi in una posizione di gestione delle relazioni rispetto al cliente entro tre anni. Potrai inizialmente sostenere senior Relationship Manager, costruire una profonda comprensione di clienti, prodotti e processi di vendita, e gradualmente assumersi più responsabilità, tra cui l'interazione cliente diretta.

Forniamo la formazione, l'esposizione e la mentorship necessari per avere successo nelle vendite istituzionali. In cambio, cerchiamo individui motivati e curiosi desiderosi di sviluppare in sviluppatori di business di fiducia e alla fine gestire rapporti di cliente istituzionali indipendentemente.

La posizione si adatta ai candidati con la prima esperienza nel servizio clienti, nel supporto vendite o nella gestione delle relazioni in asset management che sono pronti a svolgere il prossimo passo in un ruolo di vendita front-office.

Quale sarebbe il tuo ruolo?

• Supporti i Relationship Manager nella gestione e nella crescita delle relazioni con i clienti istituzionali.

• Si preparano presentazioni, materiali di vendita, aggiornamenti di mercato e recensioni di portafoglio, nonché coordinare incontri client, eventi e follow-up per garantire un'esperienza senza soluzione di continuità.

• Supporti RFP, DDQ e richieste di informazioni client.

• Mantenere i dati CRM, le pipeline di vendita e la segnalazione, nonché contribuire a migliorare il processo e iniziative digitali.

• In un secondo passo, si collegano i membri del team con una boutique di investimento Vontobel e diventare esperto di contenuti del team per questa classe di attività.

• In un ultimo passo, ti unisci agli eventi del cliente, alle riunioni e alle piazzole per imparare il ruolo di gestione delle relazioni.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• Esperienza iniziale all'interno di assistenza clienti istituzionali, supporto vendite, gestione del rapporto cliente o un ruolo simile all'interno della gestione patrimoniale.

• Una chiara ambizione di perseguire una carriera a lungo termine nella gestione delle vendite istituzionali e dei rapporti con i clienti.

• Laurea magistrale con un eccellente record accademico, alla ricerca di un'opportunità in un ambiente di lavoro internazionale

• Forte interesse per i mercati finanziari, gli investimenti e la gestione patrimoniale istituzionale.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.

• Proattivo, curioso e commercialmente pensato con un forte senso di proprietà.

• Fluency in tedesco e inglese.

• Proficiente nelle applicazioni Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint e Word), con idealmente qualche esperienza di sistemi CRM (ad esempio Salesforce) e l'uso efficace di dati e strumenti AI per l'intelligenza di mercato, la ricerca e scopi analitici.

Cosa offriamo?

• Opportunità di lavorare per un responsabile attivo leader in un ambiente internazionale e sviluppare competenze nella gestione attiva degli asset lavorando con i clienti istituzionali

• Migliore posizione a Zurigo

• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio aperto.

• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.

• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.

Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare.

A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Entro il 2030, vogliamo essere conosciuti come una delle principali e più affidabili aziende di investimento globali. Abbiamo 2.300+ professionisti impegnati, con sede in oltre 25 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo.

Siamo entrambi di proprietà della famiglia di maggioranza e pubblicamente elencati. La nostra capacità di attenzione a lungo termine, su temi come la sostenibilità, è sostenuta dalla sicurezza dell’impegno della famiglia di 100 anni. Guidato da una mentalità di proprietà, è possibile sbloccare il vostro potenziale e tradurre intuizioni in opportunità. Assumiamo individui di talento che sono determinati a consegnare in un mondo in evoluzione e che provengono da una vasta gamma di sfondi. Vuoi essere Vontobel?

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno delle nostre squadre e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se avete domande potete contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto .

Haben Sie erste Erfahrungen in der Unterstützung institutioneller Kunden im Asset Management gesammelt und möchten eine Karriere im institutionellen Vertrieb aufbauen? Wenn Sie sich für Investments, Relationship Management und Business Development begeistern, bietet diese Rolle einen starken Einstieg in einen der führenden Vermögensverwalter der Schweiz.

Innerhalb des Swiss Institutional Clients Teams unterstützen Sie Pensionskassen, Versicherer und Family Offices und tragen sowohl zur Neugeschäftsentwicklung als auch zur Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen bei.

Diese Rolle zielt auf ehrgeizige Kandidaten ab, die innerhalb von drei Jahren in eine kundenorientierte Beziehungsmanagementposition wechseln wollen. Sie werden zunächst Senior Relationship Manager unterstützen, ein tiefes Verständnis für Kunden, Produkte und Verkaufsprozesse aufbauen und schrittweise mehr Verantwortung übernehmen, einschließlich direkter Kundeninteraktion.

Wir bieten die Ausbildung, Exposition und Mentoring benötigt, um im institutionellen Verkauf erfolgreich zu sein. Im Gegenzug suchen wir motivierte, neugierige Personen, die sich zu vertrauenswürdigen Geschäftsentwicklern entwickeln und schließlich institutionelle Kundenbeziehungen unabhängig verwalten möchten.

Die Position passt zu Kandidaten mit erster Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Vertriebsunterstützung oder Beziehungsmanagement im Asset Management, die bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt in eine Front-Office-Vertriebsrolle zu gehen.

Was wäre Ihre Rolle?

• Sie unterstützen Relationship Manager bei der Verwaltung und dem Ausbau institutioneller Kundenbeziehungen.

• Top Standort Zürich

• Freundliches, vielfältiges Team in einem Open-Office-Bereich.

• Flache Hierarchie mit Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen.

Wir suchen talentierte Leute, nicht nur einen Lebenslauf, der alle Boxen ankreuzt. Auch wenn Sie nicht absolut alles haben, wonach wir gefragt haben, wenn diese Rolle nach einer guten Passform für Sie klingt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben.

Bei Vontobel bauen Sie eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft sowie für sich selbst. Wir haben über 2.300 engagierte Fachkräfte, die an über 25 Standorten weltweit ansässig sind und ihren Hauptsitz in Zürich haben.

Wir sind sowohl mehrheitlich in Familienbesitz als auch börsennotiert. Unsere Fähigkeit, sich langfristig auf Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit zu konzentrieren, wird durch die Sicherheit des 100-jährigen Engagements der Familie untermauert. Angetrieben von einer Ownership-Mentalität können Sie Ihr Potenzial freisetzen und Erkenntnisse in Chancen umsetzen. Wir stellen talentierte Personen ein, die entschlossen sind, in einer sich verändernden Welt zu liefern und die aus einer Vielzahl von Hintergründen kommen. Willst du vontobel sein?.

Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich bei Vontobel bewerben. Wir werden Ihre Bewerbung sorgfältig prüfen und Ihnen rechtzeitig antworten.

Avez-vous acquis une expérience initiale de soutien aux clients institutionnels en gestion d'actifs et voulez-vous construire une carrière dans les ventes institutionnelles? Si vous êtes passionné par les investissements, la gestion des relations et le développement des affaires, ce rôle offre une forte entrée dans l'un des principaux gestionnaires d'actifs de Suisse.

Au sein de l'équipe des clients institutionnels suisses, vous soutiendrez les fonds de pension, les assureurs et les bureaux familiaux, contribuant à la fois au développement de nouvelles entreprises et au maintien de relations clients à long terme.

Ce rôle vise les candidats ambitieux qui souhaitent occuper un poste de gestion des relations avec les clients d'ici trois ans. Vous soutiendrez d'abord les gestionnaires principaux des relations, développerez une compréhension approfondie des clients, des produits et des processus de vente, et assumerez progressivement plus de responsabilités, y compris l'interaction directe avec les clients.

Nous offrons la formation, l'exposition et le mentorat nécessaires pour réussir dans les ventes institutionnelles. En retour, nous recherchons des personnes motivées et curieuses désireuses de se développer en développeurs d'affaires fiables et éventuellement gérer les relations avec les clients institutionnels indépendamment.

Le poste convient aux candidats ayant une première expérience dans le service à la clientèle, le soutien aux ventes ou la gestion de la relation en gestion d'actifs qui sont prêts à passer à l'étape suivante dans un rôle de vente de premier plan.

Quel serait votre rôle ?

• Vous aidez les gestionnaires de relations à gérer et à développer les relations avec les clients institutionnels.

• Vous préparez des présentations, du matériel de vente, des mises à jour du marché et des examens de portefeuille ainsi que des réunions de clients, des événements et des suivis afin d'assurer une expérience transparente.

• Vous supportez les DP, les DDQ ainsi que les demandes d'information des clients.

• Vous maintenez des données CRM, des pipelines de vente et des rapports ainsi que contribuer aux améliorations des processus et aux initiatives numériques.

• Dans un deuxième temps, vous liez les membres de l'équipe à une boutique d'investissement Vontobel et devenez l'expert en contenu de l'équipe pour cette classe d'actifs.

• Dans une dernière étape, vous rejoignez des événements clients, des réunions et des emplacements pour apprendre le rôle de gestion de la relation.

Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?

• Expérience initiale dans le domaine du service à la clientèle institutionnelle, du soutien aux ventes, de la gestion des relations avec la clientèle ou d'un rôle semblable dans la gestion des biens.

• Une ambition claire de poursuivre une carrière à long terme dans les ventes institutionnelles et la gestion des relations client.

• Maîtrise avec un excellent dossier académique, à la recherche d'une opportunité dans un environnement de travail international

• Intérêt marqué pour les marchés financiers, les investissements et la gestion des actifs institutionnels.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des intervenants.

• Proactive, curieuse et commercialement soucieuse d'un fort sentiment de propriété.

• Connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais.

• Compétence en applications Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint et Word), avec idéalement une certaine expérience des systèmes CRM (par exemple Salesforce) et l'utilisation efficace des données et des outils d'intelligence artificielle à des fins d'intelligence commerciale, de recherche et d'analyse.

Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?

• Possibilité de travailler pour un gestionnaire actif de premier plan dans un environnement international et de développer une expertise en gestion active des actifs avec des clients institutionnels

• Haut lieu de Zurich

• Une équipe amicale et diversifiée dans un espace ouvert.

• Environnement agile dans notre façon de penser, notre façon de travailler et notre confiance l'un pour l'autre.

• Hiérarchie plate avec collaboration à tous les niveaux.

Nous cherchons des gens talentueux, pas seulement un CV qui coche toutes les boîtes. Même si vous n'avez pas absolument tout ce que nous avons demandé, si ce rôle vous semble bon, nous vous encourageons à postuler.

Animé par un état d'esprit de propriété, vous pouvez débloquer votre potentiel et traduire des idées en opportunités. Nous embauchons des personnes talentueuses qui sont déterminées à agir dans un monde en évolution et qui viennent d'horizons très variés. Tu veux être Vontobel ?

Merci d'avoir postulé à Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre demande et vous répondrons en temps opportun.

Sie verstehen es, sich mit sicherem und freundlichem Auftreten im Spannungsfeld verschiedener Anspruchsgruppen geschickt zu bewegen?
Für unseren Standort in Zürich suchen wir per November oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Mitarbeiter/in Reception & Hospitality Services.

• Herzliche Begrüssung und Betreuung unseres anspruchsvollen Gästekreises an unseren Standorten in Zürich.

• Koordination und Unterhalt der Besprechungszimmer.

• Vor- und Nachbereitung der Konferenzräume (z.B. Einrichtung Beamer- Präsentationen/ Auffüllen des Materials).

• Individuelle Bewirtung unserer Kunden und Gäste (In den Sitzungsräumlichkeiten und Kunden Lounges).

• Bedienung der Alarmzentrale (inkl. Öffnung und Schliessung des Haupteingangs).

• Hohes Mass an Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft zur Unterstützung der Kollegen an den Schweizweiten Vontobel Standorten.

• Sporadische Einsätze bei Abendanlässen und Kundenevents.

Was sind die Anforderungen?

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung vorzugsweise im Dienstleistungssektor, z.B. Hotellerie, Gastronomie, Flugindustrie (Cabin Crew Member) etc.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position.

• Ausgezeichnete Schweizerdeutsch-, Deutsch-, sowie gute Englisch- und Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift); weitere Sprachen von Vorteil.

• Gute PC-Anwenderkenntnisse (MS Office: Outlook, Word und Excel).

• Kundenorientierte Einstellung, hohe Serviceorientierung und Dienstleistungsbereitschaft.

• Sehr gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten, selbstständige und exakte Arbeitsweise, einwandfreie sowie diskrete Umgangsformen und Einfühlungsvermögen.

• Affinität für Artificial Intelligence (AI) und Bereitschaft, mit AI Tools zu arbeiten.

Was bieten wir?

• Top-Lage in Zürich und kostenloser Verpflegung.

• Freundliches, vielfältiges Team in einem offenen Büro.

• Agiles Arbeitsumfeld – in unserem Denken, unserer Arbeitsweise und im gegenseitigen Vertrauen.

• Flache Hierarchien mit Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen.

• Campus-Atmosphäre und ein ausgeprägter Teamgeist.

Wir suchen nach talentierten Menschen und nicht nur nach einem Lebenslauf, der alle Kriterien erfüllt. Auch wenn du nicht alles mitbringst, was wir von dir verlangen, solltest du dich bewerben.

Arbeitsort
Die Position ist derzeit in Zürich angesiedelt. Im Jahr 2030 wird der Arbeitsort nach Baar verlegt, um die Zusammenarbeit mit den wichtigsten Stakeholdern im Business weiter zu stärken.

Warum Vontobel?
Bei Vontobel gestalten Sie eine bessere Zukunft – für unsere Kunden, die Gesellschaft und ihre eigene. Als familiengeführtes, börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 2.000 Mitarbeitenden an 28 Standorten weltweit und Hauptsitz in Zürich setzen wir auf langfristiges Denken und Nachhaltigkeit.
Unser vielfältiges Team schätzt unterschiedliche Perspektiven, und wir suchen Menschen, die in einer dynamischen und sich wandelnden Welt etwas bewegen wollen. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung, wenn Sie sich für die Stelle begeistern.

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

Riesce a mantenere una visione d'insieme anche nei periodi frenetici e a lavorare in modo efficiente e preciso?

Sa muoversi abilmente, con un atteggiamento sicuro e cordiale, tra le esigenze di diversi gruppi di interesse?

Per la nostra sede di Zurigo cerchiamo, a partire da novembre o previo accordo, un/una collaboratore/collaboratrice per i servizi di reception e ospitalità.

In cosa consiste il ruolo?

- Accoglienza cordiale e assistenza dei nostri ospiti esigenti presso le nostre sedi di Zurigo.
- Coordinamento e manutenzione delle sale riunioni.
- Preparazione e riordino delle sale conferenze (ad es. installazione del proiettore e delle presentazioni / rifornimento del materiale).
- Servizio personalizzato ai nostri clienti e ospiti (nelle sale riunioni e nelle lounge per i clienti).
- Controllo degli accessi all'edificio, inclusa la gestione dei badge dei dipendenti e dei visitatori.
- Gestione della centrale d'allarme (compresa l'apertura e la chiusura dell'ingresso principale).
- Svolgimento di attività amministrative generali (ad es. gestione della casella di posta elettronica della reception, registrazione dei giustificativi di prenotazione per le fatture, ordinazione di materiale d'ufficio, ecc.).
- Gestione professionale delle chiamate in arrivo (identificazione delle richieste e inoltro ai referenti competenti).
- Elevata flessibilità e disponibilità a viaggiare per supportare i colleghi nelle sedi Vontobel di tutta la Svizzera.
- Impieghi occasionali durante eventi serali e manifestazioni per i clienti.

Quali sono i requisiti?

- Formazione professionale completata, preferibilmente nel settore dei servizi, ad es. alberghiero, della ristorazione, dell'aviazione (membro dell'equipaggio di cabina), ecc.
- Esperienza pluriennale in una posizione analoga.
- Ottima conoscenza dello svizzero tedesco e del tedesco, nonché buona conoscenza dell'inglese e del francese o dell'italiano (sia parlato che scritto); la conoscenza di altre lingue costituisce un vantaggio.
- Buone competenze nell'uso del PC (MS Office: Outlook, Word ed Excel).
- Atteggiamento orientato al cliente, spiccato orientamento al servizio e disponibilità a offrire un servizio.
- Ottime capacità organizzative, metodo di lavoro autonomo e preciso, modi impeccabili e discreti ed empatia.
- Affinità per l'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e disponibilità a lavorare con strumenti di AI.

Cosa offriamo?

- Posizione privilegiata a Zurigo e vitto gratuito.
- Team cordiale e diversificato in un ufficio open space.
- Ambiente di lavoro agile – nel nostro modo di pensare, nel nostro modo di lavorare e nella fiducia reciproca.
- Gerarchie piatte con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.
- Atmosfera da campus e spiccato spirito di squadra.

Cerchiamo persone di talento e non solo un curriculum che soddisfi tutti i criteri. Anche se non hai tutto ciò che richiediamo, dovresti candidarti.

Sede di lavoro

La posizione è attualmente a Zurigo. Nel 2030 la sede di lavoro sarà trasferita a Baar, per rafforzare ulteriormente la collaborazione con i principali stakeholder aziendali.

Perché Vontobel?

In Vontobel contribuisce a plasmare un futuro migliore – per i nostri clienti, la società e il Suo futuro. In quanto azienda a conduzione familiare quotata in borsa, con oltre 2.000 dipendenti in 28 sedi in tutto il mondo e sede centrale a Zurigo, puntiamo su una visione a lungo termine e sulla sostenibilità.

Il nostro team diversificato apprezza le diverse prospettive e cerchiamo persone che vogliano fare la differenza in un mondo dinamico e in continua evoluzione. Anche se non soddisfa tutti i criteri, saremo lieti di ricevere la Sua candidatura se è entusiasta della posizione.

Desidera entrare a far parte di Vontobel?

Grazie per aver presentato la Sua candidatura a Vontobel. Esamineremo attentamente la Sua candidatura e Le risponderemo tempestivamente.

In Vontobel, siamo un'azienda che offre pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a garantire pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, ascendenza, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.

Diamo valore alle molteplici voci presenti nei nostri team e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque desideri far parte della nostra cultura della performance possa essere sé stesso. Si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se ha domande, può contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto .

Do you know how to navigate skillfully between the competing interests of various stakeholder groups with a confident and friendly demeanor?

For our location in Zurich, we are looking for a Reception & Hospitality Services employee starting in November or by agreement.

What does the role entail?

- Welcoming and looking after our discerning guests at our locations in Zurich.
- Coordination and maintenance of the meeting rooms.
- Preparation and follow-up of the conference rooms (e.g. setting up projectors and presentations / replenishing supplies).

- Customer-oriented attitude, strong service orientation and commitment to providing service.

What do we offer?

- Friendly, diverse team in an open office.

At Vontobel, you shape a better future – for our clients, society and your own future. As a family-owned, publicly listed company with more than 2,000 employees at 28 locations worldwide and headquarters in Zurich, we focus on long-term thinking and sustainability.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description

Même en période mouvementée, savez-vous garder une vue d’ensemble et travailler efficacement et avec précision ?

Savez-vous évoluer avec tact, assurance et amabilité dans un environnement réunissant différentes parties prenantes aux intérêts divergents ?

Pour notre site de Zurich, nous recherchons, dès novembre ou à convenir, un/e collaborateur/trice en réception et services d’accueil.

En quoi consiste le poste ?

- Accueil chaleureux et accompagnement de nos hôtes exigeants sur nos sites de Zurich.
- Coordination et entretien des salles de réunion.
- Préparation et remise en ordre des salles de conférence (p. ex. installation du vidéoprojecteur et des présentations / réapprovisionnement du matériel).
- Prise en charge personnalisée de nos clients et invités (dans les salles de réunion et les salons clients).
- Contrôle d’accès au bâtiment, y compris gestion des badges des collaborateurs et des visiteurs.
- Utilisation de la centrale d’alarme (y compris l’ouverture et la fermeture de l’entrée principale).
- Exécution de tâches administratives générales (p. ex. traitement de la boîte e-mail de la réception, saisie des pièces comptables pour les factures, commande de fournitures de bureau, etc.).
- Prise en charge professionnelle des appels entrants (identifier les demandes et les transmettre aux interlocuteurs compétents).
- Une grande flexibilité et une forte disponibilité pour se déplacer afin de soutenir les collègues sur les sites Vontobel dans toute la Suisse.
- Missions ponctuelles lors de soirées et d’événements clients.

Quelles sont les exigences ?

- Formation professionnelle achevée, de préférence dans le secteur des services, p. ex. hôtellerie, restauration, industrie aéronautique (membre d’équipage de cabine), etc.
- Plusieurs années d’expérience dans un poste comparable.
- Excellente maîtrise du suisse allemand et de l’allemand, ainsi que de bonnes connaissances de l’anglais et du français ou de l’italien (à l’oral et à l’écrit) ; d’autres langues constituent un avantage.
- Bonne maîtrise de l’utilisation d’un PC (MS Office : Outlook, Word et Excel).
- Attitude orientée clientèle, sens aigu du service et disponibilité à fournir des prestations de service.
- Très bonnes compétences organisationnelles, méthode de travail autonome et précise, manières irréprochables et discrètes, ainsi que de l’empathie.
- Affinité pour l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et volonté de travailler avec des outils d’IA.

Que proposons-nous ?

- Un emplacement privilégié à Zurich et une restauration gratuite.
- Une équipe sympathique et diversifiée dans un bureau ouvert.
- Un environnement de travail agile – dans notre façon de penser, notre manière de travailler et la confiance mutuelle.
- Une hiérarchie horizontale avec une collaboration à tous les niveaux.
- Une atmosphère de campus et un fort esprit d’équipe.

Nous recherchons des personnes talentueuses et pas seulement un CV qui répond à tous les critères. Même si vous ne réunissez pas tout ce que nous demandons, vous devriez postuler.

Lieu de travail

Le poste est actuellement basé à Zurich. En 2030, le lieu de travail sera transféré à Baar afin de renforcer davantage la collaboration avec les principales parties prenantes de l’entreprise.

Pourquoi Vontobel ?

Chez Vontobel, vous contribuez à façonner un avenir meilleur – pour nos clients, la société et le vôtre. En tant qu’entreprise familiale cotée en bourse, comptant plus de 2.000 collaborateurs sur 28 sites dans le monde et dont le siège est à Zurich, nous misons sur une réflexion à long terme et la durabilité.

Notre équipe diversifiée apprécie les perspectives différentes, et nous recherchons des personnes qui souhaitent faire bouger les choses dans un monde dynamique en constante évolution. Même si vous ne remplissez pas tous les critères, nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature si le poste vous enthousiasme.

Souhaitez-vous rejoindre Vontobel ?

Nous vous remercions d’avoir posé votre candidature chez Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre candidature et vous répondrons dans les meilleurs délais.

Chez Vontobel, nous sommes un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à garantir l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi, indépendamment de la race, de la couleur de peau, de l’ascendance, de la religion, du sexe, de l’origine nationale, de l’orientation sexuelle, de l’âge, de la citoyenneté, de l’état matrimonial, du handicap ou de l’identité de genre.

Nous apprécions les nombreuses voix au sein de nos équipes et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement dans lequel toute personne qui souhaite faire partie de notre culture de la performance peut être elle-même. Celle-ci repose sur le respect mutuel et la tolérance zéro à l’égard de toute forme de discrimination.

Si vous avez des questions, vous pouvez nous contacter via notre formulaire de contact.

For our IT Security division in Zurich, we are seeking an experienced and versatile Blockchain Engineer and Architect. • Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione e pranzo gratuito.

• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.

• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.

Questo ruolo ha sede a Zurigo, ma si trasferirà a Baar nel 2030, garantendo un allineamento ravvicinato con i principali stakeholder del business.

A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.

jobs.title: AML Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about running Compliance and AML technology solutions that help safeguarding the bank and its clients? Do you enjoy supporting the day-to-day operation, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement of compliance-related applications, and working with innovative technologies including analytics and AI? Do you thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies? Join us and help us run the future Compliance architecture at Vontobel.

At Vontobel, we actively shape the future. We believe in empowering our clients – and our people – to build on their strengths and unlock new potential. Within the Legal & Compliance Platforms team, we are seeking a Compliance Operations Engineer / Application Specialist who is ready to take ownership of advanced solutions in the fields of application support, data analytics and AI.

What would your role be?
In this role, you will be responsible for critical Compliance and complex AML platforms, sanctions and adverse media screening as well as related investigation workflows. You will work closely with colleagues from Legal & Compliance, Operations and other IT colleagues to support, maintain and further develop reliable, scalable and compliant technology solutions.

• Implement and operate scalable software solutions using modern engineering best practices.

• Own the technical lifecycle of screening platforms including sanctions, PEP, adverse media and transaction screening solutions.

• Integrate external screening providers and internal banking applications through APIs and event-driven architectures.

• Partner with Compliance SMEs to translate regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions.

• Manage application upgrades, vendor releases and technical roadmaps.

• Identify and implement AI-driven solutions supporting business and engineering objectives.

• Drive automation and operational excellence across screening and investigation processes.

• Ensure auditability, traceability and regulatory compliance of implemented solutions.

• Enable end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives.

• Take ownership for project implementation including timelines, budgets, risks, and dependencies.

• Support stakeholders through actionable data analysis and intuitive data visualizations.

This role offers a high degree of ownership and autonomy. You will play a key role in operating the architecture, technology choices and strategic direction of Vontobel's Compliance and Screening platforms.

What are we looking for?

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, preferably within financial services or a regulated environment.

• Proven experience as a technical operations engineer/application specialist supporting Compliance, AML, KYC or screening solutions.

• A good understanding of sanctions screening, PEP screening, adverse media screening and AML processes.

• Hands-on experience with API development and system implementation.

• Solid knowledge of Python, GitHub, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Helm, Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, SQL / PL-SQL. Knowledge of Java, Spring and Neo4j Graph Database is a plus.

• Experience in software implementation and technical project management.

• Experience with messaging and integration technologies.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

• Fluency in English and German.

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Location Requirement
This role is based in Zurich but will move to Baar in 2030, ensuring close alignment with key stakeholders in the business.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

Are you passionate about running Compliance and AML technology solutions that help safeguarding the bank and its clients? Do you enjoy supporting the day-to-day operation, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement of compliance-related applications, and working with innovative technologies including analytics and AI? Do you thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies? Join us and help us run the future Compliance architecture at Vontobel.

At Vontobel, we actively shape the future. We believe in empowering our clients – and our people – to build on their strengths and unlock new potential. Within the Legal & Compliance Platforms team, we are seeking a Compliance Operations Engineer / Application Specialist who is ready to take ownership of advanced solutions in the fields of application support, data analytics and AI.

What would your role be?
In this role, you will be responsible for critical Compliance and complex AML platforms, sanctions and adverse media screening as well as related investigation workflows. You will work closely with colleagues from Legal & Compliance, Operations and other IT colleagues to support, maintain and further develop reliable, scalable and compliant technology solutions.

• Implement and operate scalable software solutions using modern engineering best practices.

• Own the technical lifecycle of screening platforms including sanctions, PEP, adverse media and transaction screening solutions.

• Integrate external screening providers and internal banking applications through APIs and event-driven architectures.

• Partner with Compliance SMEs to translate regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions.

• Manage application upgrades, vendor releases and technical roadmaps.

• Identify and implement AI-driven solutions supporting business and engineering objectives.

• Drive automation and operational excellence across screening and investigation processes.

• Ensure auditability, traceability and regulatory compliance of implemented solutions.

• Enable end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives.

• Take ownership for project implementation including timelines, budgets, risks, and dependencies.

• Support stakeholders through actionable data analysis and intuitive data visualizations.

This role offers a high degree of ownership and autonomy. You will play a key role in operating the architecture, technology choices and strategic direction of Vontobel's Compliance and Screening platforms.

What are we looking for?

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, preferably within financial services or a regulated environment.

• Proven experience as a technical operations engineer/application specialist supporting Compliance, AML, KYC or screening solutions.

• A good understanding of sanctions screening, PEP screening, adverse media screening and AML processes.

• Hands-on experience with API development and system implementation.

• Solid knowledge of Python, GitHub, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Helm, Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, SQL / PL-SQL. Knowledge of Java, Spring and Neo4j Graph Database is a plus.

• Experience in software implementation and technical project management.

• Experience with messaging and integration technologies.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

• Fluency in English and German.

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Location Requirement
This role is based in Zurich but will move to Baar in 2030, ensuring close alignment with key stakeholders in the business.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.

We are looking for a proactive, resilient and highly organised professional who acts with confidence, sound judgement and discretion. This is a fully office-based role supporting primarily legal matters, with opportunities to grow into broader business management responsibilities.

• Manage complex calendars, meetings and business travel with foresight and discretion.

• Coordinate management meetings, agendas, documentation and follow-up activities.

• Anticipate requirements or potential issues and follow through until matters are resolved.

• Maintain structure and momentum across competing and frequently changing priorities.

• Handle correspondence, legal documents and confidential information with due care.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.

• Take on broader business management responsibilities as the role develops.

What are we looking for?

• Experienced Executive Assistant with a strong track record supporting senior management.

• Legal Assistant or Paralegal background and familiarity with legal topics preferred.

• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

• Proactive mindset with sound judgement, discretion and attention to detail.

• Strong communication skills in German and English, both written and spoken.

• Willingness to work from our Zurich office five days per week.

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

This role is based in Zurich but will move to Baar in 2030, ensuring close alignment with key stakeholders in the business.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

Ist Java für Dich mehr als nur ein Urlaubsziel und «Spring» nicht nur eine Deiner Lieblingsjahreszeiten? Dann komm zu uns und gestalte das Wealth Management der Zukunft!
Bei Vontobel glauben wir daran, die Zukunft zu gestalten, indem wir innovative Investmentlösungen schaffen, die den Erfolg unserer Kunden fördern. Wir suchen leidenschaftliche Menschen, die etwas bewirken wollen und bereit sind, modernste digitale Lösungen zu liefern. Du wirst bei uns nicht nur ein Softwareentwickler sein – Du wirst ein zentraler Akteur in unserem Vontobel DigiHub, der in einem vielfältigen, innovativen und interdisziplinären Team arbeitet, um bahnbrechende Produkte zu entwickeln.
Unsere Lösungen umfassen die E-Banking-Plattform mit Apps für private und professionelle Kunden, die digitale Investment-App Vontobel Volt, ein digitales Onboarding, eine Applikation für risikobasierte Investmentberatung, sowie kollaborative Tools, mit welchen Berater gemeinsam mit Kunden Produktkonfigurationen und Simulationen durchführen können. Wir nutzen eine modernen Tech Stack mit u.a. Angular, Spring Boot und OpenShift (Kubernetes), und arbeiten in einem agilen Arbeitsumfeld.

Und Du möchtest die Entwicklung unserer E-Banking Lösung zum wichtigsten digitalen Kundenkanal in unserem hybriden Geschäftsmodell aktiv mitgestalten? Dann haben wir die perfekte Herausforderung für dich im Vontobel DigiHub.

Was wären Deine Tätigkeiten?
Als Senior Full-Stack Engineer wirst Du Teil des agilen, funktionsübergreifenden Teams aus Entwicklern, Business Engineers, UX-Experten, Scrum Master und Product Owner, welches die Vontobel E-Banking Plattform verantwortet.

• Entwicklung neuer Funktionen über den gesamten Stack unter Verwendung moderner Technologien und Agentic Engineering mittels GitHub Copilot.

• Verantwortung über den gesamten Softwareentwicklungs- und Betriebsprozess (Anforderungsanalyse, Design, Implementierung, Testing, Rollout und Betrieb).

• Umsetzung von Automatisierungen in den Build-, Test- und Deployment-Prozessen mit CI/CD-Technologien, um eine hohe Softwarequalität sicherzustellen.

• Themenverantwortung sowie deren eigenständige und strukturierte Umsetzung in Abstimmung mit verschiedenen Stakeholder.

• Mit einer Vielzahl interner und externer Stakeholder zusammenarbeiten, um die besten Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Was suchen wir?

• Einen Abschluss in Informatik oder Softwareentwicklung (ETH, Universität, FH, Schweizerisches eidgenössisches Diplom).

• Mind. 6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung über den gesamten Lebenszyklus (Analyse, Design, Implementierung, Testing und Deployment), idealerweise in einem agilen oder DevOps-Umfeld.

• Praktische Erfahrung im Aufbau von Webanwendungen mit modernen Single Page App Frameworks (Angular, SCSS) und Microservice-Architekturen basierend auf Kotlin und Java.

• Erfahrungen im Bankenumfeld und Investmentwissen, vorzugsweise im Umfeld E-Banking inklusive Avaloq.

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich.

• Affinität für Artificial Intelligence (AI) und Bereitschaft, mit AI Tools zu arbeiten.

Was bieten wir?

• Start-up-Groove und die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft des digitalen Bankings zu revolutionieren.

Java è per te più di una semplice destinazione per le vacanze e «Spring» non è solo una delle tue stagioni preferite? Allora vieni da noi e contribuisci a plasmare la gestione patrimoniale del futuro!

In Vontobel crediamo di plasmare il futuro creando soluzioni d'investimento innovative che favoriscono il successo dei nostri clienti. Cerchiamo persone appassionate che vogliano fare la differenza e siano pronte a offrire soluzioni digitali all'avanguardia. Da noi non sarai soltanto uno sviluppatore software – sarai un protagonista centrale del nostro Vontobel DigiHub, che lavora in un team eterogeneo, innovativo e interdisciplinare per sviluppare prodotti pionieristici.

Le nostre soluzioni comprendono la piattaforma di e-banking con app per clienti privati e professionali, l'app d'investimento digitale Vontobel Volt, un onboarding digitale, un'applicazione per la consulenza d'investimento basata sul rischio, nonché strumenti collaborativi con i quali i consulenti possono realizzare insieme ai clienti configurazioni di prodotti e simulazioni. Utilizziamo uno stack tecnologico moderno con, tra gli altri, Angular, Spring Boot e OpenShift (Kubernetes), e lavoriamo in un ambiente di lavoro agile.

Ti piace assumerti responsabilità, hai una spiccata mentalità DevOps e sei motivato a lavorare in un team agile? E vuoi contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo della nostra soluzione di e-banking, affinché diventi il principale canale digitale per i clienti nel nostro modello di business ibrido? Allora nel Vontobel DigiHub abbiamo la sfida perfetta per te.

Quali sarebbero le tue mansioni?

Come Senior Full-Stack Engineer entrerai a far parte del team agile e interfunzionale composto da sviluppatori, Business Engineers, esperti UX, Scrum Master e Product Owner, responsabile della piattaforma di e-banking Vontobel.

- Sviluppo di nuove funzionalità sull'intero stack utilizzando tecnologie moderne e l'Agentic Engineering tramite GitHub Copilot.
- Responsabilità dell'intero processo di sviluppo e operatività del software (analisi dei requisiti, design, implementazione, testing, rollout e operatività).
- Implementazione di automazioni nei processi di build, test e deployment con tecnologie CI/CD, per garantire un'elevata qualità del software.
- Assunzione di compiti di supporto di 2nd/3rd livello per i sistemi al cui sviluppo contribuisci. Inoltre, il team svolge servizi di reperibilità; è richiesta la disponibilità a svolgere tali servizi.
- Proposta di nuove idee per migliorare le soluzioni e i processi all'interno del team e dell'intero DigiHub.
- Assunzione della responsabilità di determinati temi e loro attuazione autonoma e strutturata in coordinamento con diversi stakeholder.
- Collaborazione con numerosi stakeholder interni ed esterni per ottenere i migliori risultati.

Che cosa cerchiamo?

- Un titolo di studio in informatica o sviluppo software (ETH, università, FH, diploma federale svizzero).
- Almeno 6 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software lungo l'intero ciclo di vita (analisi, progettazione, implementazione, testing e deployment), idealmente in un ambiente agile o DevOps.
- Esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di applicazioni web con moderni framework per Single Page App (Angular, SCSS) e architetture a microservizi basate su Kotlin e Java.
- Esperienza nel settore bancario e conoscenze in ambito d'investimenti, preferibilmente nell'ambito dell'e-banking, incluso Avaloq.
- Costituisce un plus l'esperienza nello sviluppo iOS/Android.
- Sono richieste buone conoscenze del tedesco e dell'inglese.
- Affinità per l'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e disponibilità a lavorare con strumenti di AI.

Cosa offriamo?

- Spirito da start-up e la possibilità di rivoluzionare il futuro del settore bancario digitale.
- Ambiente di lavoro agile con Big Room Plannings, gilde e community trasversali ai team, revisioni e demo con clienti e stakeholder.
- Postazioni di lavoro ottimamente attrezzate in posizione centrale a Zurigo, ampio spazio per la collaborazione, MacBook Pro di ultima generazione come strumento di lavoro. Per il 2030 è previsto il trasferimento a Baar, in uno dei business park più moderni della Svizzera.
- Modalità di lavoro con 1 giorno fisso di home office alla settimana (mercoledì o venerdì).
- Pranzo gratuito nel ristorante aziendale di alta qualità, caffè gratuito, frutta fresca ogni giorno, calcio balilla e aperitivi per celebrare i successi.

Cerchiamo persone di talento, non soltanto un curriculum che soddisfi tutti i criteri. Anche se non possiedi tutto ciò che richiediamo, dovresti candidarti.

La posizione ha attualmente sede a Zurigo. Nel 2030 il luogo di lavoro sarà trasferito a Baar, per rafforzare ulteriormente la collaborazione con i principali stakeholder dell'azienda.

Perché Vontobel?

In Vontobel contribuisce a plasmare un futuro migliore – per i nostri clienti, la società e il suo futuro. In quanto azienda a conduzione familiare quotata in borsa, con oltre 2.000 dipendenti in 28 sedi in tutto il mondo e sede centrale a Zurigo, puntiamo su una visione a lungo termine e sulla sostenibilità.

Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive diverse e cerchiamo persone che vogliano fare la differenza in un mondo dinamico e in continua evoluzione. Anche se non soddisfa tutti i criteri, saremo lieti di ricevere la sua candidatura se è entusiasta della posizione.

Desidera entrare a far parte di Vontobel?

Description

Is Java more than just a holiday destination for you, and is Spring more than just one of your favorite seasons? Then join us and shape the Wealth Management of the future!

At Vontobel, we believe in shaping the future by creating innovative investment solutions that promote our clients’ success. We are looking for passionate people who want to make a difference and are ready to deliver state-of-the-art digital solutions. Here, you will not just be a software developer—you will be a key player in our Vontobel DigiHub, working in a diverse, innovative and interdisciplinary team to develop groundbreaking products.

Our solutions include the E-Banking platform with apps for private and professional clients, the digital investment app Vontobel Volt, digital onboarding, an application for risk-based investment advice, as well as collaborative tools that advisors can use together with clients to carry out product configurations and simulations. We use a modern tech stack including Angular, Spring Boot and OpenShift (Kubernetes), among others, and work in an agile environment.

Do you enjoy taking responsibility, have a strong DevOps mindset and are motivated to work in an agile team? And would you like to actively help shape the development of our E-Banking solution into the most important digital customer channel in our hybrid business model? Then we have the perfect challenge for you at the Vontobel DigiHub.

What would your responsibilities be?

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will become part of the agile, cross-functional team of developers, Business Engineers, UX experts, Scrum Master and Product Owner responsible for the Vontobel E-Banking platform.

- Developing new features across the entire stack using modern technologies and Agentic Engineering with GitHub Copilot.
- Taking responsibility for the entire software development and operations process (requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, rollout and operations).
- Implementing automation in the build, test and deployment processes using CI/CD technologies to ensure a high level of software quality.
- Taking on 2nd/3rd-level support tasks for the systems you co-develop. In addition, the team provides on-call services, and a willingness to participate is required.
- Contributing new ideas to improve solutions and processes within the team and throughout the DigiHub.
- Taking ownership of topics and implementing them independently and in a structured manner in coordination with various stakeholders.
- Collaborating with a large number of internal and external stakeholders to achieve the best results.

What are we looking for?

- A degree in computer science or software development (ETH, university, FH, Swiss Federal Diploma).
- At least 6 years of experience in software development across the entire lifecycle (analysis, design, implementation, testing and deployment), ideally in an agile or DevOps environment.
- Practical experience in building web applications with modern Single Page App Frameworks (Angular, SCSS) and microservice architectures based on Kotlin and Java.
- Experience in the banking sector and investment knowledge, preferably in an E-Banking environment including Avaloq.
- Bonus points for experience in iOS/Android development.
- Good German and English skills are required.
- An affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to work with AI Tools.

What do we offer?

- Start-up vibe and the opportunity to revolutionize the future of digital banking.
- Agile working environment with Big Room Plannings, cross-team guilds and communities, reviews and demos with clients and stakeholders.
- Well-equipped workplaces in a central location in Zurich, plenty of space for collaborative work, and a latest-generation MacBook Pro as a work device. A move to Baar, to one of Switzerland’s most modern business parks, is planned for 2030.
- Workmode with 1 regular home-office day per week (Wednesday or Friday).
- Free lunch in the high-quality employee restaurant, free coffee, fresh fruit every day, table football and celebratory drinks.

We are looking for talented people and not just a résumé that meets all the criteria. Even if you do not have everything we ask of you, you should apply.

Location

The position is currently based in Zurich. In 2030, the workplace will be relocated to Baar to further strengthen collaboration with the most important stakeholders in the business.

Why Vontobel?

At Vontobel, you are shaping a better future—for our clients, society and yourself. As a family-run, publicly listed company with over 2,000 employees at 28 locations worldwide and headquarters in Zurich, we focus on long-term thinking and sustainability.

Our diverse team values different perspectives, and we are looking for people who want to make a difference in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you do not meet all the criteria, we look forward to receiving your application if you are enthusiastic about the position.

Would you like to become Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.

We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur des affaires et des risques

jobs.description:
Are you an avid Business & Risk Manager who wants to make an impact? In our role you act as the operational and control backbone for the region. You bridge front-office teams with Zurich central functions (Finance, HR, Risk, Compliance, Legal) by translating regional strategy into budgets, staffing plans, and rigorous first-line controls.

The role splits roughly 40% business management, 40% first-line risk and control, and 20% regulatory readiness.

What would your role be?
1. Business Management & Planning (40%)

• Financial Oversight: Build and track regional budgets (revenue, cost, headcount) with monthly variance analysis.

• Resource Strategy: Develop forecasting models, resource plans, and headcount proposals with HR.

• Management Reporting: Produce regional KPI scorecards (revenue, net new money, cost/income ratio, pipeline capacity).

• Strategic Execution: Implement group-wide cost initiatives, process changes, and system rollouts locally.

2. First-Line Risk & Control (40%)

• Control Framework: Own, run, and document the regional first-line control framework.

• AML & KYC Oversight: Monitor onboarding files, KYC/EDD quality, and periodic reviews; escalate compliance gaps early.

• Incident Management: Track operational errors, incidents, and client complaints; lead root-cause analysis and remediation.

• Audit Coordination: Coordinate internal/external audits and drive audit findings through full closure.

• RCSA & KRIs: Maintain the regional Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and report Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to leadership.

3. Regulatory Readiness (20%)

• Regulatory Implementation: Support the rollout of regulatory strategies (e.g., CRD VI implementation).

• Compliance Standards: Oversee mandatory staff training and certifications.

• Inspections: Prepare and support the region for regulatory reviews and inspections.

What are we looking for?

• 8–12 years in Swiss private banking or wealth management (COO office, business management, or 1st-line risk/control).

• Deep understanding of FINMA circulars, AMLA/AMLO, and cross-border rules.

• Proven financial budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and advanced Excel/PowerPoint capabilities.

• Track record of managing strategic group-level projects or system rollouts.

• Highly credible with senior front-office bankers, with the ability to constructively challenge when necessary.

• Highly rigorous, structured, discreet, and capable of working independently across multiple sites.

• Fluent in French and English; working knowledge of German is strongly preferred for Zurich collaboration.

• Experience with GCC/Middle East clients or the External Asset Manager (EAM) segment is a plus.

What we offer

• Top Geneva location

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space with modern equipment.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration on all levels.

• Campus feeling and collaborative spirit.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 29 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

• Standard di conformità: supervisionare la formazione obbligatoria del personale e le certificazioni.

• Ispezioni: Preparare e sostenere la regione per le recensioni e le ispezioni regolamentari.

• Prova budgeting finanziario, previsione, analisi varianza e funzionalità avanzate Excel/PowerPoint.

• Tracciare il record di gestione di progetti strategici a livello di gruppo o rollout di sistema.

• Altamente credibile con banchieri di front-office senior, con la capacità di sfida costruttivamente quando necessario.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno dei nostri team e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se avete domande potete contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto .

Bei Vontobel bauen Sie eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft sowie für sich selbst. Als familiengeführtes und börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 2.000 Fachleuten an 29 Standorten weltweit mit Hauptsitz in Zürich setzen wir auf langfristiges Denken und Nachhaltigkeit.

Êtes-vous un gestionnaire d'affaires et de risques avide qui veut faire un impact? Dans notre rôle, vous agissez comme l'épine dorsale opérationnelle et de contrôle pour la région. Vous établissez un lien entre les équipes de première direction et les fonctions centrales de Zurich (Finances, RH, Risque, Conformité, Légal) en traduisant la stratégie régionale en budgets, plans de dotation et contrôles rigoureux de première ligne.

Le rôle consiste à répartir environ 40 % de la gestion des entreprises, 40 % des risques et du contrôle de première ligne et 20 % de l'état de préparation réglementaire.

Quel serait votre rôle ?
1. Gestion et planification des activités (40 %)

• Surveillance financière : Établissement et suivi des budgets régionaux (recettes, coûts, effectifs) avec analyse des écarts mensuels.

• Stratégie en matière de ressources : Élaborer des modèles de prévision, des plans de ressources et des propositions de dénombrement avec RH.

• Rapports de gestion : produire des cartes de pointage régionales de l'ICP (revenus, nouveaux fonds nets, rapport coûts-revenus, capacité des pipelines).

• Exécution stratégique : Mettre en oeuvre des initiatives de coûts à l'échelle du groupe, des changements de processus et des déploiements de systèmes au niveau local.

2. Risque et contrôle de première ligne (40 %)

• Cadre de contrôle : possède, exécute et documente le cadre de contrôle régional de première ligne.

• Surveillance AML & KYC: Surveiller les fichiers embarqués, la qualité KYC/EDD et les examens périodiques; aggraver les lacunes de conformité tôt.

• Gestion des incidents : suivre les erreurs opérationnelles, les incidents et les plaintes des clients; diriger l'analyse des causes profondes et l'assainissement.

• Coordination de la vérification : Coordonner les vérifications internes et externes et mener les constatations de la vérification jusqu'à la clôture complète.

• RCSA & KRI: Maintenir l'auto-évaluation des risques et des contrôles au niveau régional et faire rapport aux dirigeants des indicateurs de risque clés.

3. État de préparation à la réglementation (20 %)

• Mise en oeuvre de la réglementation : Appuyer la mise en oeuvre de stratégies réglementaires (p. ex. mise en oeuvre de la DRC VI).

• Normes de conformité : Superviser la formation et les certifications obligatoires du personnel.

• Inspections : Préparer et appuyer la région pour les examens et les inspections réglementaires.

Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?

• 8-12 ans en banque privée ou gestion de patrimoine suisse (bureau de COO, gestion d'entreprise, ou 1ère ligne risque/contrôle).

• Connaissance approfondie des circulaires FINMA, AMLA/AMLO et des règles transfrontalières.

• Budget financier éprouvé, prévisions, analyse de la variance et capacités avancées Excel/PowerPoint.

• Suivre l'état de la gestion des projets stratégiques au niveau des groupes ou des déploiements de systèmes.

• Très crédible avec des banquiers de premier plan, avec la capacité de défier de façon constructive au besoin.

• Très rigoureux, structuré, discret et capable de travailler indépendamment sur plusieurs sites.

• Fluent en français et en anglais; la connaissance de l'allemand est fortement préférée pour la collaboration de Zurich.

• L'expérience avec les clients du GCC/Middle East ou avec le segment External Asset Manager (EAM) est un plus.

Ce que nous offrons

• Haut lieu de Genève

• Équipe amicale et diversifiée dans un espace de bureau ouvert avec des équipements modernes.

• Toutes les dernières technologies pour vous aider à exceller et à progresser.

• Environnement agile dans notre façon de penser, notre façon de travailler et notre confiance l'un pour l'autre.

• Hiérarchie plate avec collaboration à tous les niveaux.

• Sensation de campus et esprit de collaboration.

Pourquoi Vontobel ?
Chez Vontobel, vous construisez de meilleurs avenirs pour nos clients et notre société, ainsi que pour vous-même. En tant qu'entreprise familiale et cotée en bourse avec plus de 2 000 professionnels basés dans 29 sites à l'échelle mondiale et ayant son siège à Zurich, nous sommes engagés dans la pensée et la durabilité à long terme.

Notre équipe diversifiée valorise des perspectives uniques, et nous embauchons des personnes déterminées à livrer dans un monde dynamique et changeant. Même si vous ne répondez pas à tous les critères, nous vous encourageons à postuler si vous êtes enthousiaste au sujet du rôle.

Tu veux être Vontobel ?

Merci d'avoir postulé à Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre demande et vous répondrons en temps opportun.

À Vontobel, nous sommes un lieu de travail à égalité des chances. Nous sommes attachés à l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi, indépendamment de la race, de la couleur, de l'ascendance, de la religion, du sexe, de l'origine nationale, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'âge, de la citoyenneté, de l'état matrimonial, du handicap ou de l'identité de genre.
Nous apprécions les nombreuses voix au sein de nos équipes et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où tous ceux qui veulent faire partie de notre culture de la performance peuvent être eux-mêmes. Elle repose sur le respect mutuel et la tolérance zéro pour toute forme de discrimination.

Si vous avez des questions, vous pouvez nous contacter via notre formulaire de contact.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about Fixed Income investing, particularly in Emerging Markets? Do you thrive in client-facing roles where you can act as a trusted advisor, not just a product pusher? Are you ready to leverage your expertise to drive global engagement and build substantial books of business? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!

At Vontobel, a leading investment firm managing over CHF 114bn in client assets, we are on an exceptional growth journey. With investment boutiques in New York (Quality Growth), London (TwentyFour Asset Management), and Zurich (Fixed Income, Multi Asset, Conviction Equities), we are seeking a Client Portfolio Manager (CPM) to champion our Emerging Markets Fixed Income (EM FI) flagship products.

As a CPM, you will play a pivotal role in representing our boutique investment team in the client experience, including prospect and consultant engagements. You will bring your client servicing and investment expertise and commercial acumen to advanced prospect situations, deliver exceptional client service, and act as a trusted advisor with a consultative, solution-oriented mindset. Reporting to the head of Fixed Income CPM, this entrepreneurial role offers the opportunity to be at the forefront of our global growth strategy while working closely with our Portfolio Managers, country client teams, RFP team and senior management.

This role is based in Zurich, offering a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment where you can thrive and grow.

What would your role be?

• Originate and validate investment messaging, marketing materials, and written content, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance

• Ensure excellence in RFP responses, reporting, client engagement preparation, follow-up, and communication, setting industry-leading standards

• Represent the Emerging Markets Fixed Income Investment team in client, prospect, and consultant meetings, articulating our investment philosophy, strategy, and portfolio positioning with authority and clarity

• Collaborate with regional client teams to execute the EM FI engagement plan, including finals presentations, roadshows, event presentations, and performance review meetings

• Take a proactive, commercial perspective in advanced sales processes and client retention, co-leading business development initiatives to achieve sustainable growth

• Maintain in-depth knowledge of investment strategies by attending meetings, reviewing research, and leveraging information services to credibly represent the Investment Team

• Ensure excellence is desk based activities such as client servicing, RFP responses and content creation

• Drive impactful prospect and client meeting activity

• Support the growth of regionally prioritized EM FI products in alignment with the integrated sales plan, including training

• Build a strong reputation for Emerging Markets Fixed Income within all client region

• Be recognized internally and externally as their trusted EM FI expert and advisor, fostering long-term partnerships

• Ensure the accuracy and compliance of all external communications and materials

What are we looking for?

• A deep interest in Emerging Markets Fixed Income and the ability to communicate this enthusiasm to clients and stakeholders.

• A track record of building books of business and excelling in client-facing roles, including winning finals presentations and handling performance review meetings.

• The ability to tailor communication to diverse audiences across regions and formats, from one-on-one meetings to keynote speeches.

• Proficient in technology and automation including AI, MS Office, with strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint; Bloomberg and programming/scripting languages (VBA or Matlab) are a plus

• At least 2+ years of Fixed Income sell-side experience and institutional investment firm expertise.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or related field, Master Degree a plus

• CFA and/or other investment designations a plus

• A proactive, self-driven approach to working in a dynamic, investment-led team and international environment

• Willingness to travel extensively, both domestically and internationally, to meet the demands of a dynamic client engagement schedule.

• Native in German and fluency in English is required; additional languages like French and Italian are a plus.

• Experienced, diverse team in an international environment

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive

Porterete la vostra assistenza clienti e le competenze di investimento e acume commerciale a situazioni prospettive avanzate, fornire un servizio clienti eccezionale, e agire come consulente affidabile con una mentalità consultiva, orientata alla soluzione. Segnalandosi al capo di Fixed Income CPM, questo ruolo imprenditoriale offre l'opportunità di essere all'avanguardia della nostra strategia di crescita globale, lavorando a stretto contatto con i nostri Portfolio Manager, team di clienti di paese, team RFP e senior management.

Questo ruolo è basato a Zurigo, offrendo un ambiente dinamico e imprenditoriale dove si può prosperare e crescere.

Qual è il tuo ruolo?

Role Dettagli

• Rappresentare il team Emerging Markets Fixed Income Investment in incontri di clienti, prospettive e consulenti, articolando la nostra filosofia di investimento, strategia e posizionamento portafoglio con autorità e chiarezza

• Collabora con i team di clienti regionali per eseguire il piano di fidanzamento EM FI, tra cui presentazioni finali, roadshow, presentazioni di eventi e incontri di revisione delle prestazioni

• Prendere una prospettiva proattiva e commerciale nei processi di vendita avanzati e la ritenzione dei clienti, iniziative di sviluppo aziendale leader per raggiungere una crescita sostenibile

• Mantenere una conoscenza approfondita delle strategie di investimento partecipando alle riunioni, alla revisione della ricerca, e sfruttando i servizi di informazione per rappresentare credibilmente il Team Investimenti

Consegna chiavi

• Assicurare l'eccellenza è attività basate su scrivania come servizio client, risposte RFP e creazione di contenuti

• Guidare la prospettiva e l'attività di riunione del cliente

• Sostenere la crescita dei prodotti EM FI a priorità regionale in linea con il piano di vendita integrato, compresa la formazione

• Costruire una forte reputazione per mercati emergenti reddito fisso all'interno di tutta la regione cliente

• Essere riconosciuti internamente ed esternamente come loro fidato esperto e consulente EM FI, promuovendo partnership a lungo termine

• Assicurare l'accuratezza e la conformità di tutte le comunicazioni e materiali esterni

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• Un profondo interesse per i mercati emergenti Risultato Fisso e la capacità di comunicare questo entusiasmo ai clienti e agli stakeholder.

• Un track record di costruzione di libri di business e di excelling in ruoli client-facing, tra cui le presentazioni finali vincenti e la gestione delle riunioni di revisione delle prestazioni.

• La capacità di adattare la comunicazione a diversi pubblico in regioni e formati, da incontri one-on-one a discorsi keynote.

• Proficiente di tecnologia e automazione, tra cui AI, MS Office, con competenze forti in Excel e PowerPoint; Bloomberg e linguaggi di programmazione/scrittura (VBA o Matlab) sono un plus

• Almeno 2+ anni di esperienza sul versante del reddito fisso e di esperienza delle imprese di investimento istituzionali.

• Laurea in finanza o campo relativo, Master Degree a plus

• CFA e/o altre denominazioni di investimento

• Un approccio proattivo e self-driven al lavoro in un team dinamico e guidato dagli investimenti e in un ambiente internazionale

• Volontà di viaggiare ampiamente, sia a livello nazionale che internazionale, per soddisfare le esigenze di un programma di fidanzamento del cliente dinamico.

• Il nativo in tedesco e la fluenza in inglese è richiesto; lingue aggiuntive come francese e italiano sono un plus.

Cosa offriamo?
